scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Do you want to build connections without being in a guild?
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
您想在不加入公會的情況下建立人脈嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Can't find the perfect guild for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
找不到適合自己的完美公會嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
You can join or leave clans freely! Just join!
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
您可以自由地加入或退出氏族！直接加入吧！

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Now, come on in and meet the masters of the Kingdom's best clans!
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
現在，請進來見見王國最強氏族的師父們吧！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Hi! I'm Raffam, master of the ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
你好！我是拉法姆，盧恩·米德加茲王國^3131FF劍氏族^000000的師父。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族資訊

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什麼是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Sword Clan
scripts.translation: 關於劍氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are a type of guild ran by the Kingdom.
They don't participate in the Siege, so members are free to join/leave anytime.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
^3131FF氏族^000000是由王國管理的一種公會。
它們不參與攻城戰，因此成員可以隨時自由加入或退出。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
I wish we could join the Siege. I'd love flying over on my dragon and burning everyone in my way!
Oops, too thrilled!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
真希望能參加攻城戰。我想騎著龍飛過去，把擋路的人都燒掉！
哎呀，太興奮了！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Join us, if no Clan suits your taste.
New members are given ^3131FFfree stat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
如果沒有合適的氏族，就加入我們吧。
新成員將獲得^3131FF免費的狀態加成^000000。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Melee stats are offered as the name ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 suggests, but not all members are Melee classes.
Don't feel pressured, just count on me!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
正如^3131FF劍氏族^000000的名字所示，我們提供近戰狀態加成，但並非所有成員都是近戰職業。
別有壓力，儘管放心交給我！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Differences in variety creates the fun.
These odd bunches never bore me in the party.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
多樣的差異才造就了樂趣。
這群怪人在一起組隊時，從來不會讓我感到無聊。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
And who knows you might meet your soul mate in the Clan? Hahah!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
說不定你還能在氏族裡遇到你的靈魂伴侶呢？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
The ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 mainly supports Melee adventurers.
Join for free ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
^3131FF劍氏族^000000主要支援近戰冒險者。
免費加入即可獲得^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Remember, no Siege participation.
You should contact other guilds for Siege.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
請記住，氏族不參與攻城戰。
如果您想參加攻城戰，應該聯絡其他公會。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
A question?
Excited to join me? Hahah!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
有什麼問題嗎？
迫不及待想加入了嗎？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Oh, you'll join? Good choice!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
哦，你要加入？不錯的選擇！
讓我們先檢視氏族政策，開始入會程式吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
You with me so far?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
^3131FF氏族成員^000000不能參與攻城戰。
新成員將獲得以下狀態加成：^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Clan masters exist for reason, like I.
Understood?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
你可以隨時加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超過2周^000000未登入，你將被^FF0000驅逐^000000。
氏族長老的存在是有原因的，比如我。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Great, sign your name here to register.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
很好，請在這裡簽名以完成註冊。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
So, you're ^3131FF{0}^000000! Nice name!
Let me register you.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
原來你是^3131FF{0}^000000！名字不錯！
讓我為你辦理註冊。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Come back to join after you leave your current guild.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
請先退出你當前的公會，然後再回來加入。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Eh? Oh, you're in a Clan.
Don't mess with me, it's not cool!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
咦？哦，你已經在氏族裡了。
別開玩笑了，這很不酷！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Welcome to the ^3131FFSword Clan^000000!
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
At your service!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
歡迎來到^3131FF劍氏族^000000！
你可以按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000檢視氏族資訊。
隨時為您服務！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
哎呀。讓我們從頭開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
哎呀。讓我們從頭開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
You want to leave?
No problem. I hope you'll find a more suitable Clan.
Ready for withdrawal?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
你想退出？
沒問題。希望你能找到更合適的氏族。
準備好退出了嗎？

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Wait, you're not with us! Grr, don't make me breathe fire at you!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
等等，你不在我們這裡！哼，別逼我對你噴火！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Hey, talk to your guild master if you want to leave.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
嘿，如果你想退出，去和你的公會會長談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Okay, it's done. But let's not be strangers, okay?
It was nice having you!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
好了，辦完了。但我們別做陌生人，好嗎？
很高興有你！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
I'm Devon, master of the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
我是德文，^3131FF言靈氏族^000000的長老。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族資訊

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什麼是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Arc Wand Clan
scripts.translation: 關於言靈氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are ran by the Kingdom, not privately like others.
And I manage one of them.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
^3131FF氏族^000000是由王國管理的，不像其他組織那樣是私人的。
而我負責管理其中一個。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
What's with that look? You got a problem?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
...
你這是什麼表情？你有意見嗎？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Brother, you're scaring a potential member, be nice.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
哥哥，你嚇到潛在的成員了，請客氣點。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
...

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Join if you are seeking a place to fit in. We give ^3131FFfree bonus stats^000000. But no Siege participation.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
如果你正在尋找一個歸屬的地方，可以加入。我們提供^3131FF免費的狀態加成^000000。但不能參與攻城戰。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Most members are offensive Mage classes as the name ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 suggests, but that's no requirement.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
正如^3131FF言靈氏族^000000的名字所暗示的那樣，大多數成員是攻擊型魔法師職業，但這不是必要條件。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...Hey, Shaam Rumi.
Stop hitting on my brother and get to work.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
...嘿，沙姆·魯米。
別老纏著我哥哥，快去幹活。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
隨便你！

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...Hmpf!
Listen, Crossbow Clan's master is evil.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
...哼！
聽著，十字弓公會的師父是個壞人。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Get over me, Devon! Don't spread rumors!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
別纏著我，德文！別到處造謠！

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Haha. Stop it. You two are making a scene.
Come on, back to work guys.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
哈哈。夠了。你們兩個別鬧了。
好了，大家繼續工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
The ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 mainly supports offensive Mage classes.
We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members. Don't ask for more; it's the Kingdom's rule.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
^3131FF言靈氏族^000000主要支援攻擊型魔法師職業。
我們為新成員提供^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。別要求更多了；這是王國的規定。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 can't participate in the Siege.
If you like the Siege, then go join a regular guild.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
^3131FF氏族成員^000000不能參與攻城戰。
如果你喜歡攻城戰，那就去加入普通的公會吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
That is all. No questions.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
就這些。別問問題。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
...
那我們來看看氏族政策，開始入會程式吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
You with me so far?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
^3131FF氏族成員^000000不能參與攻城戰。
新成員將獲得這些狀態加成：^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你聽懂了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
你可以隨時加入或離開氏族，但如果你^FF0000超過2周^000000未登入，你將被^FF0000開除^000000。
你同意嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Sign your name here.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
在這裡簽上你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FF{0}^000000.....
Good, let me invite you in.

[Devon Aire]
Leave your guild first to join my Clan, duh.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
想加入我的氏族，先退出你的公會，笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You're already in a Clan. You joking?!
Oh, I can be funny, too--FIRE PILLAR!
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
你已經在某個氏族裡了。你在開玩笑嗎？！
哦，我也會開玩笑的——火柱攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You have joined the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
你已加入^3131FF言靈氏族^000000。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
So don't bother me later.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
你可以用^3131FFCtrl+G^000000檢視氏族資訊。
所以別再來煩我了。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
That's all. Visit often or be expelled. Dismissed.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
就這些。經常來，否則會被開除。解散。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Then I don't want you.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
那我不要你了。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Gosh, listen to the policy again.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
天哪，再聽一遍政策吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Want to leave, huh?
I understand, it's about Sieges. If not, why are..Never mind..
I'll process your withdrawal.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
想退會嗎？
我理解，大概是因為攻城戰吧。如果不是的話……算了……
我會處理你的退會申請。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Naughty children deserve a good Jupitel Thunder.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
不聽話的孩子，就該嚐嚐雷鳴術的滋味。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You're barking up the wrong tree. Go to your Clan master.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
你找錯人了。去找你的氏族長吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You are withdrawn from the Clan.
Now leave. I don't feel like talking anymore.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
你已退出氏族。
現在離開吧。我不想再說話了。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Nice to meet you. I'm Berman Aire, master of the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
I'm also the older brother of Devon Aire. Devon looks tough, but he's kind hearted.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
很高興見到你。我是^3131FF黃金之錘氏族^000000的長，伯曼·艾爾。
我也是德文·艾爾的哥哥。德文雖然看起來兇，但心地很善良。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族資訊

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什麼是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Golden Mace Clan
scripts.translation: 關於黃金之錘氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are established by the Kingdom to help adventurers connect and share information.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
^3131FF氏族^000000是由王國設立的，旨在幫助冒險者建立聯絡並分享資訊。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Because the Kingdom runs the Clan, there is no Siege participation, but at least the members are given ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
The stat bonuses are small, but can be very useful for beginning adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
因為氏族由王國管理，所以無法參加攻城戰，但至少成員可以獲得^3131FF屬性加成^000000。
雖然加成很小，但對於初出茅廬的冒險者來說非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
We're named the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000, but we don't discriminate against applicants based on their classes.
The name is just to help you easily choose your Clan.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
我們名為^3131FF黃金之錘氏族^000000，但並不會根據職業歧視申請者。
這個名字只是為了讓你更容易選擇氏族。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Berman, enough with the explanation. Let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
伯曼，別解釋那麼多了。我們去葛拉斯特海姆逛逛吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
... Hey.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
……喂。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ooh, you're scaring me.
Berman, call me when you can!~
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
噢，嚇死我了。
伯曼，你有空的時候叫我哦！~

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Hah hah, I apologize for their bickering.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
哈哈，抱歉讓他們吵起來了。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Do you have a question?
If you're tired of traveling alone, join us! You can join and leave the Clan anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
你有什麼問題嗎？
如果你厭倦了獨自旅行，就加入我們吧！你可以隨時加入或退出氏族。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
The ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000 mainly helps supportive classes.
We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
^3131FF黃金之錘氏族^000000主要幫助輔助型職業。
我們為新人提供^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
As I told you earlier, Clans cannot join the Siege because they already belong to the Kingdom.
If you want to be in the Siege, then I recommend you join a regular guild.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
正如我之前所說，氏族因為隸屬於王國，所以無法參加攻城戰。
如果你想參加攻城戰，我建議你加入普通的公會。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Do you understand what the Clans are about now?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
現在你明白氏族是做什麼的了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Great!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
太好了！
那我們來看看氏族政策，開始入會手續吧。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
^3131FF氏族成員^000000不能參加攻城戰。
作為我們的新成員，你將獲得以下屬性加成：^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你同意嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you agree to maintain good standing in the Clan?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
你可以隨時加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超過2周^000000未登入，你將^FF0000被開除^000000。
你同意在氏族中保持良好的狀態嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Now, please write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
那麼，請在這裡寫下你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
^3131FF{0}^000000! What a good name!
Okay, then...
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
^3131FF{0}^000000！真是個好名字！
那麼，接下來...

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Oh, no.
In order to join, you first have to leave your current guild.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
哦，不行。
要加入氏族，你必須先退出你當前的公會。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You're already in a Clan.
You're just confused, right?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
你已經在一個氏族裡了。
你只是搞混了吧？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Welcome to the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000!
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
歡迎來到^3131FF黃金之錘氏族^000000！

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
你可以按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000檢視氏族資訊。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Please remember the few precautions I gave you, and enjoy your Clan activities!
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
請記住我剛才提到的注意事項，享受你的氏族活動吧！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
With meeting, there is parting.
I hope you enjoyed your time in the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
Now, should I process your withdrawal?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
有相聚就有離別。
希望你在^3131FF黃金之錘氏族^000000的時光是愉快的。
那麼，我現在為你辦理退出手續嗎？

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can't leave the Clan without joining it first.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
你還沒加入氏族，不能退出。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
I'm sorry, but I can't remove you from another Clan...
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
很抱歉，我無法將你從其他氏族中移除...

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
It's processed.
Come back anytime to the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000. I'll be here.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾爾]
已經辦理好了。
隨時歡迎回到^3131FF黃金之錘氏族^000000。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Hi, there! I'm Shaam, master of the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
嗨！我是沙姆，^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000的師父。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族資訊

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什麼是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Crossbow Clan
scripts.translation: 關於十字弓氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The Clans were established by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to...
Raffam, why were our ^3131FFclans^000000 made?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
氏族是由盧恩·米德加茲王國建立的，用來...
拉法姆，我們的^3131FF氏族^000000是為了什麼而建立的？

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Did you sleep in class? Gosh.
The Clans help lone adventurers connect with each other and share information.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奧蘭佩爾]
上課睡覺了嗎？真是的。
氏族幫助孤獨的冒險者彼此聯絡並分享資訊。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
A-ha, got it! Thank you, Captain!
You heard that too, right?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
啊哈，明白了！謝謝你，船長！
你也聽到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Run by the Kingdom itself, the Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege, but the good news is that the members are given some ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
氏族由王國直接管理，不允許參與攻城戰，但好訊息是成員會獲得一些^3131FF屬性加成^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
In case you wonder if the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 only recruits Archers, no, it doesn't.
All the Clans accept all classes. You can choose the one that suits your needs best.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
如果你想知道^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000是否只招募弓箭手，答案是：不。
所有氏族都接受所有職業。你可以選擇最適合你需求的那個。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
That should cover everything there is to know.
Berman, let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
該說的都說了。
伯曼，我們去葛拉斯特海姆逛逛吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You...
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾爾]
你...

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ooh, scary! You're so protective of your brother.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
哇，好可怕！你對哥哥真是保護欲滿滿啊。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 is ideal for ranged classes.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000非常適合遠端職業。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Eh, let me check the Clan manual. Ah, and we offer stat bonuses to new members: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
嗯，讓我查一下氏族手冊。啊，對了，我們為新人提供屬性加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege; you should join a private guild instead for Siege.
The Clans are for adventurers that hate being tied down.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
氏族不允許參與攻城戰；如果你想參加攻城戰，應該加入私人公會。
氏族適合那些討厭被束縛的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Do you have a question?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
你有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Oh, yeah? Good choice!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
哦，是嗎？不錯的選擇！
那我們來檢視一下氏族政策，開始入會手續吧。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
^3131FF氏族成員^000000不能參與攻城戰。
作為我們的新成員，你將獲得以下屬性加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你同意嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you promise you'll maintain good standing?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
你可以隨時加入或離開氏族，但如果^FF0000超過2周^000000未登入，你將被^FF0000除名^000000。
你保證會保持良好狀態嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Good, write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
很好，在這裡簽上你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
^3131FF{0}^000000..!
Ugh, your penmanship needs work. Let me process your application.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
^3131FF{0}^000000...！
嘖，你的字真難認。讓我來處理你的申請。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Did you finish things up with your guild?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
你和公會那邊都處理好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Eh, you're already in a Clan. Hey, this isn't funny.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
嗯，你已經在氏族裡了。嘿，這不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Welcome to the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
歡迎來到^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
你可以按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000檢視氏族資訊。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Don't pick fights with other clansmen. Be social.
If you need help, you can always whisper me, okay? See you around!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
不要和其他氏族成員打架。要友善。
如果需要幫助，隨時可以密語我，好嗎？再見！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
All right then. I'm just going to go have some fun.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
那麼，我就去玩了。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ah, do you need time to think about this? No problem.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
啊，你需要時間考慮一下嗎？沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Why, did you find a better Clan?
I'm disappointed, but it's your call. Let me process your withdrawal.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
怎麼，你找到了更好的氏族？
我很失望，但這是你的選擇。讓我來處理你的退會申請。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
I can't let you leave--you're not even in my Clan!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
我不能讓你離開——你甚至不在我的氏族裡！

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Sorry, but I don't meddle with other Clans' business.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
抱歉，我不干涉其他氏族的事務。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
It's done.
If you ever miss us, don't hesitate to come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·魯米]
手續辦好了。
如果你以後想我們了，隨時歡迎回來，好嗎？

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個錯誤。
